system.description: Whether through a weak will, a lingering mortal anomaly, or overuse of ritual components like kalif, you have become addicted to the alchemical psychoactive drugs some sorcerers use to focus their blood magic. This dependence goes beyond ordinary addiction, actually affecting your mastery of Assamite Sorcery. You must bid two extra Traits on all challenges related to your blood magic (including path powers and rituals) whenever you are not under the influence of your drug of choice. Only characters with at least one basic Assamite Sorcery power may take this Flaw (non-Assamites who somehow receive tutelage in the Discipline may also take it). Roleplay your character's drug use — do not actually use drugs yourself.
